scope: read-only fallback attribution; no explicit failure reason logs; conservative stationary occupancy evidence
method: Replay exact finite BatteryPool using actual reserve/complete events and removed SOC; verify final snapshot exact. At each charge_reserved proxy, inspect latest <=10s frame; stable idle blocker means home point match, idle stage and no departure event since frame before current event_seq. This establishes observed endpoint occupancy, not planner trace or a count of rejected candidate reasons.
